name: Strahd von Zarovich
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Strahd fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: Strahd makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, Strahd can grapple it (escape {@dc 18}) instead of dealing the slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken.

legendary.name: Move (1 Action)
entries: Strahd moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

fluffEntries: **O Lorde Desafiado:** surge no fim do ritual não para matar, mas para isolar o grupo em Haunted Zones. Na oneshot ele nunca luta de verdade: aparece nas zonas, comenta, testa e foge ao sofrer dano massivo (veja Evento 4).
